title: Quasi-affineness pushes down along a finite surjective morphism in two situations
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for a finite surjective morphism with quasi-affine source, the target is quasi-affine when the morphism is finite locally free or when the target is integral normal (statement lines 3915-3924). The counted proof is short: each case is reduced to one of the cited norm statements, for which a norm of the appropriate degree exists, and then to the result that the norm of a quasi-affine morphism along a morphism admitting a norm is quasi-affine (proof lines 3926-3932). It is H2: the two reductions are carried out in the counted span and the cited inputs are statements of the same chapter, two of which are cards of this lane.
